title: Pure Noble Knight
summary: Pure Noble Knight build led by the Infernoble Knight Synchro engine alongside classic Arthurian Knights and Noble Arms Equip Spells. FIRE Warriors send, search, and equip each other from the GY to climb through Infernoble Knight Captain Roland into Infernoble Knight Emperor Charles and Link-1 Emperor Charles the Great.

summary.title: Starters
points: Infernoble Knight Ogier sends any FIRE Warrior or Noble Arms card from the Deck to the GY when Normal or Special Summoned, and equips itself from the GY to a Warrior you control.

Heritage of the Chalice searches any Noble Knight monster or Noble Arms card from the Deck or GY, and "Infernoble Arms - Durendal" destroys itself while equipped to search any Level 5 or lower FIRE Warrior.

Noble Knight Medraut Special Summons a Noble Knight from the Deck when equipped with a Noble Arms while you control no other monsters, and The Continuing Epic of Charles reveals a Noble Arms in hand to summon an Infernoble Knight from the Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Infernoble Knight Ogier + Renaud
steps: Normal Summon Infernoble Knight Ogier and send Infernoble Knight Turpin (or Infernoble Knight Ricciardetto / "Infernoble Arms - Durendal") from the Deck to the GY.
Special Summon Infernoble Knight - Renaud from the hand as a Level 1 Tuner and recover the card Ogier sent (or equip Ogier from the GY so Turpin revives itself).

Synchro Summon Level 5 Infernoble Knight Captain Roland, activate Captain Roland's effect to queue an End Phase search, and tune Captain Roland + a Level 4 Warrior into Level 9 Infernoble Knight Emperor Charles.

Equip Emperor Charles from the GY (using Ogier, Roland, or Captain Roland), then Link Summon Link-1 Emperor Charles the Great using the equipped Emperor Charles and re-equip Emperor Charles from the GY for 3500 ATK and a Spell/Trap negate.

summary.title: GY Equip Loop & Charles Evolution
summary.text: Infernoble Knights treat the GY as a second Equip Zone: Ogier, Oliver, Maugis, Roland, and Captain Roland can all equip themselves from the GY (or hand, for Roland and Captain Roland as a Quick Effect) to a Warrior you control. Whenever an Equip Card is equipped to any monster on the field, Infernoble Knight Emperor Charles destroys 1 card on the field without targeting, and during each End Phase it equips an Equip Spell from the hand or GY and a FIRE Warrior from the Deck.

summary.title: Extra Deck & Payoff
points: Emperor Charles the Great (Link-1 made from a Level 9 Infernoble Knight Emperor Charles equipped with an Equip Card) equips Emperor Charles from the GY to gain its effects and 500 ATK, and sends an Equip Spell from your hand or field to the GY once per turn to negate and destroy a Spell/Trap activation.
Infernoble Knight Captain Roland equips itself from the GY as a Quick Effect to a Warrior you control, triggering Emperor Charles's non-targeting pop on the opponent's turn.
Artorigus, King of the Noble Knights and Sacred Noble Knight of King Custennin provide Rank 4 Arthurian Xyz backrow removal and multi-card bouncing.

summary.title: Spells & Left out
points: "Infernoble Arms - Durendal" searches a Level 5 or lower FIRE Warrior, "Infernoble Arms - Joyeuse" adds a FIRE Warrior from the GY to your hand or summons one from the hand, and Glory of the Noble Knights equips a Noble Knight with any Equip Spell directly from the Deck.
Wonko, Noble Knight of the Forest draws a card when Special Summoned and forces attacks onto itself while a Field Spell is out.
Left out: Isolde, Two Tales of the Noble Knights is Forbidden in the TCG, and Fairy Tale Prologue: Journey's Dawn for Wonko's Field Spell search is omitted.
